hubTrigger.claim: Meat supply was expected to tighten as ASF persisted, supporting substitution toward chicken and other proteins.
Domestic pork output was expected to fall about 15%, with import growth unable to fully remove the shortage risk.

candidate.name: 民和股份

companyEvidence.claim: 2019Q1 attributable profit forecast raised to RMB370-390m because chick prices rose more than previously expected.
2019H1 attributable profit forecast RMB800-960m, +4244% to +5113%, due mainly to much higher commercial chick prices.

labelRationale: The profit explosion came from the company's existing core chick-price cycle.
ASF adds substitution demand, but upstream white-feather-chicken supply tightness was already an independent and widely-followed driver.
This is therefore a known core cycle with an additional demand tailwind, not a new profit pool.
risks: equity may already price the shortage
ASF substitution is hard to separate from domestic chicken supply constraints
